lines.text: Hey, nice to meet ya. I’m LeBooBoo. Richard and Yu have been working real hard on the game. Trust me, I’ve been living here the whole month…

Rich let me crash in a spare room while a new show gets filmed at my haunted cabin. They said the filming wouldn’t be invasive then they pulled out a ghost radar, and it got a little awkward. But hey! You should visit me out here some time. Awesome tube run right out back…

Anyways, Richard and Yu are getting into costume. They’ll be down soon. I’ll have you head back into the control room. I have to make some style updates to the wall, but go ahead and take us live when you’re ready.
